title: Trading 212 Portfolio Position
description: Open position in a Trading 212 Invest or Stocks ISA account.

avg_price.description: Average entry price in minor units of the instrument currency.

current_price.description: Current market price in minor units of the instrument currency.

unrealised_pnl.description: Unrealised profit/loss in minor units of the account currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the monetary values.

account_type.description: Trading 212 account type the position belongs to.

position_value_minor.description: Computed market value of the position in minor units, derived by the sync job as quantity * current_price.

portfolio_weight_pct.description: Computed weight of this position as a percentage of total portfolio value, derived by the sync job.
